study_identification_part.si_4_title: Cortical thickness and grey-matter volume anomaly detection in individual MRI scans: Comparison of two methods

dc_1_datasets_using_in_this_study.detail: OASIS3 (Open Access Series of Imaging Studies) dataset with AD and HC scans.
dc_1_datasets_using_in_this_study.supporting_text: we focussed the analysis on OASIS3 (Open Access Series of Imaging Studies; LaMontagne et al., 2019), a large and freely available dataset containing clinical grade high-resolution isotropic T1-weighted MRI scans of patients with Alzheimer ' s disease (AD) and healthy controls (HC).

answer.OASIS-3: normative model training on CDR=0 non-converters; evaluation/analysis of AD (CDR ≥ 1) and HC scans (LOOCV).

dc_2_purpose_of_each_dataset.detail: CDR=0 non-converter scans used to build the normative models; AD/HC scans in the same dataset used for evaluation and LOOCV-based analyses.
dc_2_purpose_of_each_dataset.supporting_text: Those scans were excluded from building our normative model, which was therefore based on 1 ' 927 scans from 696 non-converting subjects, see Table 1 for demographic information.; AD patients with established dementia (CDR ≥ 1, 209 scans) are shown in rows 1 and 3, results of the LOOCV in cleaned non-converting HCs (CDR = 0, 1 ′ 828 scans) in rows 2 and 4.

dc_3_number_of_healthy_control_of_each_n.detail: Final normative models were built from 1,828 HC scans after removing 99 anomalous scans; initial modeling used 1,927 HC scans before cleaning.
dc_3_number_of_healthy_control_of_each_n.supporting_text: The 99 HC scans with large number of anomalies (5.15 %) were removed before our final normative models were built from the of 1 ′ 828 remaining HC scans.

dc_4_age_info_of_each_normative_nodel.detail: Age at scan for CDR=0 non-converters used for normative models (Table 1).

dc_5_sex_info_of_each_normative_nodel.detail: Sex distribution reported for CDR=0 non-converter scans; male counts inferred by subtraction from total scans (1,927 - 1,188).
